'''Anomaly 1033''' was an anomaly in space. The ''[[Lady Luck/Legends|Lady Luck]]'' visited around a [[Light-second/Legends|light-second]] from the anomaly while searching for the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]''. It was theorized to be something left behind on an expedition to [[Carconth]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
